title: Date range defaults to This Month when nothing is saved and no range is in the page link
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. Your browser has no saved view for this report (first visit, or clear the browser's site data first).
2. You open the report by its plain address with no date range in the page link.
steps: 1. Open the Sales By Customer report.
2. Read the date range picker's current value.
expected: 1. The date range picker shows "This Month."
